name: What defines a 'sanctuary-style' bathroom design?

acceptedAnswer.text: A sanctuary-style bathroom transforms an everyday space into a spa-like retreat focused on comfort, functionality, and elevated aesthetics. This typically involves thoughtful layout design, premium material selections, sophisticated lighting, and specialized fixtures such as large walk-in showers with frameless glass, freestanding tubs, and integrated storage solutions. AKN Design Group focuses on harmonizing these elements to create a cohesive, calming experience tailored to your lifestyle.
acceptedAnswer.description: A sanctuary-style bathroom is a spa-like retreat with premium materials, sophisticated lighting, and specialized fixtures designed for comfort and elevated aesthetics.
